486b4f689b7c967997b8fca68bdc4f2d83200443: Adelboden and Lenk are linked by the Hahnenmoos pass and form a 86 km ski area in the Bernese Oberland. Adelboden hosts the World Cup giant slalom on the Chuenisbärgli every year. The area, mostly blue runs, lends itself well to families. As the price of the day ticket is dynamic, the price shown is an estimate. The breakdown of runs is given as a percentage of kilometres by difficulty.
